what: Ada writes a version of her creator's seat row on A, and from a second copy of her store a move at the same seq on B. The id is equivocated on both copies after either merge, and Ada is an equivocator: every seat row of hers counts for nothing, so none is a head of the roster, and her session is void; each merge reports AUTHOR_EQUIVOCATED (D160, D171, R10). Before R10 the version alone was no head and her earlier seat rows stayed heads.
